exercises.name: Rotational Side Toss (Scoop)
exercises.intent: Ground-up sequencing: rear hip drives, trunk transmits, arms are passive.
exercises.terminationRule: Terminate set on 5% decay from best rep.
exercises.regression: Half-kneeling side toss - removes lower-body variable
exercises.progression: Step-behind approach, then rotational throw off a single-leg finish

exercises.name: Step-Behind Rotational Throw
exercises.intent: Adds horizontal momentum - closer to golf's transfer demand.
exercises.terminationRule: Terminate set on 5% decay from best rep.
exercises.progression: Increase approach distance before increasing ball weight

exercises.name: Overhead-to-Floor Rotational Chop Slam
exercises.intent: Rotational deceleration under load - the quality nobody trains and everybody needs.

exercises.name: Rotational Side Toss - Prime
exercises.restPurpose: Full recovery - this block may not generate fatigue
exercises.intent: Frequency preservation, not development. Post-activation prime for the grinds.
exercises.terminationRule: Terminate on ANY decay. Hard cap 12 total throws.
exercises.progression: None - this block does not progress

exercises.name: Acceleration
exercises.intent: Horizontal force at max intent - cleanest available transfer to hip drive.

exercises.name: Crossover / Lateral Shuffle to Sprint
exercises.intent: Frontal-plane force acceptance.

exercises.name: KB Swing (Ballistic Hinge)
exercises.restPurpose: Antiglycolytic - rest until HR returns to ~120 bpm. Rest IS the prescription.
exercises.intent: Alactic hip power, repeatable, zero lactate accumulation.
exercises.terminationRule: Terminate when rep 5 loses peak float.
exercises.progression: Add sets before load. 20 sets before weight moves.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.intent: Strength-speed. Bar speed is the target, not the load.
exercises.progression: Load moves only when all reps clear 0.85 m/s

exercises.name: Anti-Rotation Iso, Loaded
exercises.intent: Reinforces the transfer medium after it has been loaded rotationally.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.intent: Maximal strength through a torso-demanding squat. Front rack taxes the pillar directly.
exercises.progression: Add load when all 5 sets clear 0.35 m/s. Wave 5/3/2 in Block 2 R5-R7.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.intent: Pulling strength; grip load is intentional.

exercises.name: Standing Press
exercises.intent: Vertical push through a stable pillar.
exercises.note: Single-arm variant adds anti-rotation cost - use it in Blocks 1 and 3.

exercises.name: RDL
exercises.intent: Posterior chain under length. Support work - not a competing max effort.
exercises.progression: Load only when position holds at rep 5

exercises.name: Loaded Carry
exercises.intent: Pillar under load in gait. The most honest test of trunk stiffness in the program.
exercises.terminationRule: Terminate when ribs flare or lateral lean appears.

exercises.name: Front Squat - Minimum Dose
exercises.intent: Top-end strength maintenance only.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up - Minimum Dose
exercises.intent: Top-end strength maintenance only.

exercises.name: Pogo / Ankle Stiffness
exercises.intent: Tendon stiffness. Elastic return is the cheapest speed in golf and the first thing lost after 35.
exercises.terminationRule: Terminate the set the moment GCT rises.

exercises.name: Drop Jump
exercises.intent: Reactive strength index development.
exercises.progression: Raise box only when RSI improves at current height
exercises.target: Box height that maximizes RSI - not the tallest box

exercises.name: Rotational Bound / Rotational Hop
exercises.intent: Elastic quality in the transverse plane - the bridge between plyo and the throws.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat
exercises.intent: Unilateral structural work. Sub-grinding by design.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Row
exercises.intent: Anti-rotation under pulling load.

exercises.name: Neck - 4 Directions, Isometric
exercises.intent: MMA durability. Sits here because it is the lowest-CNS day and neck work must not compete with anything.

exercises.name: Grip - Thick-Bar or Towel Hold
exercises.intent: Combat durability; secondary transfer to club control.

exercises.name: Norwegian 4x4
exercises.restPurpose: Active @ 60-70% HRmax - clears H+, keeps stroke volume elevated
exercises.intent: VO2max. Central adaptation - stroke volume and cardiac output.
exercises.terminationRule: If HR fails to reach 90% during interval 1, this is not a VO2max session. Abort to 25 min Zone 2 and LOG AS A MISSED EXPOSURE.
exercises.progression: Add interval 5, or raise power output at fixed HR
exercises.modalityNote: Open. Rower and ski erg carry real posterior chain and trunk cost; bike and treadmill isolate the stimulus. In Block 3 use bike or treadmill so ESD does not compete with velocity work.

substitutionTags.label: Max-Intent Rotational Velocity
substitutionTags.targetQuality: Max-intent rotational velocity. Alactic. Peak power through hip-trunk separation.
substitutionTags.dosingSignature: 3-rep sets, 90s rest, terminate on 5% velocity decay, <=36 total max-intent efforts, zero lactate accumulation, full recovery between every set.
substitutionTags.validSubstitution: Any max-intent rotational effort meeting the same dosing signature. Range or bag/pad work in an antiglycolytic cadence qualifies - 3 max-intent swings or strikes, 90s complete rest, terminate on speed decay, <=36 total efforts. Overspeed golf training qualifies. Sled or throw-based rotational work qualifies.
substitutionTags.invalidSubstitution: Continuous range sessions. Any striking work with incomplete rest, regardless of perceived intensity. Volume swing work. Technical practice at sub-max intent. A 45-minute range session is not this block - it is 200 sub-max reps with no decay termination, which develops skill and blunts velocity.
substitutionTags.failureMode: Substituting glycolytic or high-volume work here silently deletes the primary emphasis while feeling like more work.

substitutionTags.label: Alactic Ballistic Hip Power
substitutionTags.targetQuality: Alactic hip power, repeatable. Anti-glycolytic by design.
substitutionTags.dosingSignature: 10x5, 60-90s rest, HR returns to ~120 bpm between sets, no burn, no breathlessness.
substitutionTags.validSubstitution: Any ballistic hip-dominant pattern at the same work:rest and HR-recovery signature. Repeated max-intent takedown entries with full recovery. Repeated jump or throw sets.
substitutionTags.invalidSubstitution: Anything producing sustained elevated HR or local burn. Kettlebell complexes, EMOM circuits, and 'conditioning with kettlebells' are the exact opposite of this block - same tool, inverted energy system. Rounds of anything.

substitutionTags.label: Velocity Prime (Non-Fatiguing)
substitutionTags.dosingSignature: 12 total throws, max intent, 90s rest, terminate on any decay.
substitutionTags.validSubstitution: 12 max-intent golf swings or rotational strikes with 90s rest between sets of 3.
substitutionTags.invalidSubstitution: Anything above 12 efforts. Volume defeats the block's purpose - it exists to preserve frequency without adding fatigue to a strength day.

substitutionTags.label: Elastic / Reactive
substitutionTags.targetQuality: Elastic/reactive - tendon stiffness, RSI, short ground contact.
substitutionTags.dosingSignature: <90 total contacts, GCT-terminated, submaximal amplitude, full rest.
substitutionTags.validSubstitution: Any reactive/elastic modality with contact-time quality control - jump rope at speed with GCT discipline, reactive footwork, low-amplitude bounding.
substitutionTags.invalidSubstitution: Fatigue-based jumping. High-volume rope as conditioning. Any plyometric work performed after ESD. Amplitude-maximizing jump work.

substitutionTags.label: VO2max
substitutionTags.targetQuality: VO2max. Central - stroke volume and cardiac output.
substitutionTags.dosingSignature: 4x4 min @ 90-95% HRmax, 3 min active recovery @ 60-70%. 16 minutes total time in zone. Time-in-zone is the entire prescription.
substitutionTags.validSubstitution: Any modality meeting the same HR and duration profile. 4-minute grappling rounds alternated with 4-minute rest qualify - but only if HR is measured and actually reaches 90-95% for the majority of each round. Assault bike, ski erg, rower, treadmill, hill repeats, uphill carries all qualify at the correct HR.
substitutionTags.invalidSubstitution: Any glycolytic work that feels hard but does not hold 90-95% HRmax for 4 continuous minutes. Specifically: 30s-2min interval formats, circuit training, 'hard rounds' without HR data, most sparring. These are lactate tolerance work, not VO2max work. Same recovery cost, different adaptation.
substitutionTags.failureMode: Assuming a hard session was a 4x4. Wear the strap or log it as a miss.

substitutionTags.label: Zone 2 Aerobic Base
substitutionTags.targetQuality: Aerobic base - mitochondrial density, capillarization, fat oxidation.
substitutionTags.dosingSignature: 45-60 min continuous at or just below LT1. Conversational. Nasal breathing sustainable.
substitutionTags.validSubstitution: Any continuous modality at the correct intensity. Walking a course while carrying qualifies - 18 holes walking is 3-4 hours of Zone 1-2. Light technical drilling at controlled HR qualifies.
substitutionTags.invalidSubstitution: Anything with HR excursions above LT1. Riding a cart. Intermittent effort of any kind - intervals do not aggregate into Zone 2.

testDefs.name: Exos Movement Screen + Pillar Checks
testDefs.note: Gates all progression. A failed pillar position stops the block.

testDefs.name: Seated MB Rotational Throw
testDefs.note: Delta vs standing tells you where the leak is.

testDefs.name: Drop Jump - RSI
testDefs.note: Box height held constant across tests.

testDefs.name: Zone 2 Output at Fixed HR
testDefs.note: Most sensitive marker of aerobic drift in this battery.

testDefs.name: Club Head Speed
testDefs.note: Headline metric for the golf emphasis.

testDefs.name: Smash Factor
testDefs.note: Skill metric. Expect slow movement. Do not attribute to this program.

testDefs.name: Output Decay R1 to R3
testDefs.note: Decay percentage matters more than absolute output.

testCadence.note: Whichever threshold hits first triggers. Both counters shown - rotation counts drift against calendar time.

progressionGate.note: A block does not advance if the movement screen fails or if two or more power metrics have regressed. Display only - the app does not block advancement.

maxIntentThrows.note: Intent unchanged. Reducing intent trains slow.
